description: Instantiate a self-contained Jump-Flooding-Algorithm Voronoi generator (stained-glass / cell pattern) as GLSL TOPs — seeds → jfa_init → K halving passes → color_pass → null. Exposes live PaletteMode / SeedCount / Speed / Jitter / EdgeThickness / EdgeColor / ColorA / ColorB controls and previews the output TOP. Pass count auto-derives from resolution (log2(max(w,h))); override with step_count.

edge_color.description: Border colour as hex (e.g. '#000000'). Live 'EdgeColor' RGB swatch.

edge_thickness.description: Cell border width in UV units (0..0.05). Live 'EdgeThickness' control.

jitter.description: Per-seed drift amplitude (0 = static lattice). Live 'Jitter' control.

palette_image.description: Op path to a TOP sampled at seed UVs when palette_mode='from_image'.

palette_mode.description: random = HSV per seed; duotone = mix(ColorA, ColorB); from_image = sample image.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path; container 'jfa_voronoi' is created inside.

resolution.description: Output resolution [width, height]; JFA pass count auto-derived from max axis.

seed_count.description: Number of Voronoi seeds (4..512). Drives the seed TOP width (next pow-2).

speed.description: Animation speed multiplier driving uTime drift of seeds. Live 'Speed' control.

step_count.description: Manual JFA pass count (0 = auto = ceil(log2(max(w,h)))).

name: create_jfa_voronoi
title: Create JFA Voronoi
